subject: general
question: Which of the following is the largest fair in West Bengal?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gangasagar Mela.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gangasagar Mela** is the **largest** fair in **West Bengal.**
 
• Gangasagar Mela is held annually in **January **on the occasion of **Makar Sankranti.**
 
• It is held on **Sagar Island** at the confluence of the** Ganges and Bay of Bengal.**
 
• The fair attracts a huge number of** pilgrims **who come to take a holy dip in the water.
 
• The fair also has various stalls selling **religious items, handicrafts, and food.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Raas Mela** is a popular fair held in **Cooch Behar** district of West Bengal.

 
 
• It is celebrated during the Hindu month of** Kartik (October-November).**
 
• The fair is known for its cultural programs, especially the **Raas Leela dance.**
 
• It also has various stalls selling **handicrafts, food, and toys.**
 
 
 
• **Jaydev Kenduli Mela** is held in **Birbhum district** of West Bengal.
 
 
• It is held in **January** on the occasion of Makar Sankranti.
 
• The fair is known for its **Baul music and dance** performances.
 
• It also has various stalls selling **handicrafts, food, and clothes.**
 
 
 
• **Ramkeli Mela** is held in **Malda** district of West Bengal.
 
 
• It is held in **February-March.**
 
• The fair is known for its **classical music** performances.
 
• It also has various stalls selling** handicrafts, food, and clothes.**
